laticrete/254-platinum.source: 80 to 95 ft2 per 50 lb bag (7.4 to 8.8 m2 per 22.7 kg) with a 6 x 6 mm notched trowel; 60 to 70 ft2 (5.6 to 6.5 m2) with 6 x 9 mm; 35 to 40 ft2 (3.2 to 3.7 m2) with 12 x 12 mm
laticrete/254-platinum.caveat: Laticrete prints the area a 22.7 kg bag covers, so these are that divided out. The trowel decides it: a 12 x 12 mm notch uses more than twice what a 6 x 6 mm does.

laticrete/myk-latafix-305.source: Approx. 55 to 60 sq ft per 20 kg pack using a 1/4 x 1/4 inch trowel

tiers.label: 6 x 6 mm notched trowel, as the sheet states

laticrete/myk-latafix-305.caveat: The sheet quotes 55 to 60 square feet from a 20 kg pack, which is 3.59 to 3.91 kg per square metre. It states the figure only for a 6 x 6 mm notch, so a deeper trowel will use more.

laticrete/myk-laticrete-325-high-flex.source: Approx. 55 to 60 sq ft per 20 kg pack using a 1/4 x 1/4 inch trowel

tiers.label: 6 x 6 mm notched trowel, as the sheet states

laticrete/myk-laticrete-325-high-flex.caveat: The sheet quotes 55 to 60 square feet from a 20 kg pack, which is 3.59 to 3.91 kg per square metre, stated for a 6 x 6 mm notch.

laticrete/myk-laticrete-190.source: 1 litre covers approximately 75 to 100 sq ft depending on the porosity of the surface
laticrete/myk-laticrete-190.caveat: The sheet gives area per litre, so this is the inverse: 75 to 100 square feet from a litre is 0.108 to 0.144 litres per square metre. A porous stone takes the higher figure.

laticrete/spectralock-pro-premium-grout.reason: Laticrete publishes the coverage for this grout as a chart on a separate sheet, Data Sheet 254.3 APD, rather than as a rate here. Quantity depends on the tile size and the joint, so send us those and we will work it out with you.

laticrete/myk-laticrete-sp-100-tile-join.reason: MYK publishes the coverage for SP-100 as a chart that depends on tile size and joint width rather than as a single rate. Send us the tile size and joint and we will work the quantity out with you.

laticrete/9235-waterproofing-membrane.reason: This is the waterproofing and anti-fracture fabric, supplied by the roll. The sheet points to the latex membrane's own data sheet for a coverage figure, so there is nothing to calculate from here.
